doc: The CONTRACT_CODES codes that no omx-contract reader or check raises, each with the code of another package that raises it. Every other code is raised by an arm in this repository's tests.

codes.contract.descriptor.face-differs: omx-plugins tools/face-descriptor-check.mjs: a built CLAP or LV2 face, scanned, against the plugin's authored descriptor
codes.contract.item.unknown: omx-contract src/c/omx_domain.c: a lookup of an item the domain does not declare (tested by test/c/domain_test.c)
codes.contract.word.unknown: omx-contract src/c/omx_domain.c: a lookup of a word or a range name the item does not declare (tested by test/c/domain_test.c)
codes.contract.index.range: omx-contract src/c/omx_domain.c: a lookup of an index at or past the item's word count (tested by test/c/domain_test.c)
